Cline's file editing tools (replace_in_file and write_to_file) suffer from widespread reliability issues that significantly impact user productivity and increase API costs. - replace_in_file fails with 'Diff Edit Mismatch' even when search blocks exactly match file content
- Models get stuck in infinite retry loops, burning through tokens and API costs

- Users must start entirely new tasks when hitting token limits, losing all progress

**Context Management Issues:**
- Entire file contents are sent to the API instead of usin

• Large workspaces become corrupted even when checkpoints are disabled
• Task cancellation or API timeouts leave repositories in broken .git_disabled state

items.title: Fix Checkpoint System Issues

## Environment

* **Cline VS Code Extension:** 4.1.9 (Next)

- **`run_commands` output is cut at 8,000 characters** — the LLM never sees the full result, then wastes an extra round-trip saying "The output was truncated. Let me capture the full output to a file and read it." and calling `read_files`.
